pages.name: Alekhine Defense: Scandinavian Variation, Myers Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 castled and put a rook on e1 with the f1-bishop still home; plan 2 called the pressure on f6 a pin (the e7-pawn blocks it). Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine Defense: Spielmann Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...e6 with White's pawn on e6 and ...Be7 with the e7-pawn in the way. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine: Scandinavian, Exchange
pages.notes: Plan 3 recaptured bxc3 before any exchange; plan 1 pushed c2-c4 through the c3-knight; the overview called the structure symmetrical. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine: Scandinavian, Exchange, 4.Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 1 said Nf3 gains time against the queen; plan 2 read d6 and d8 as moves. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine: Two Pawns Attack, 5.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 1 read d4 as a move; plan 2 read d4 as a move too. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine: Two Pawns Attack, 5.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 3 recaptured bxc3 and dxc3 before any exchange. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine Defense: Four Pawns Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 named long castling and a kingside attack as the main plan. Rewrote plan 1 (reviewer: first draft still claimed long castling, rejected, revised to d4-d5, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine: Exchange, 5...exd6
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the knight via c8 to d6, where Black's pawn stands; plans 1 and 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1-3 (reviewer: a d7-f6 route rejected as unconfirmed, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine Defense: Modern Variation, Larsen Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 pressed a d6-pawn that has gone after 4...dxe5. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine: Modern, 4...c6
pages.notes: The overview and plan 1 had Black push ...d5 onto the knight's square and pressure an e4-pawn that is on e5. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling.
